formats.description: One self-contained file with the styling inline. It opens with no network at all: no stylesheet link, no script, no font, no image from anywhere.
Everything: the units, their requirement coverage, the validation results and the provenance of every committed version. The format to keep, and the one to diff.
The units in reading order, as plain Markdown. No provenance, no coverage — the document as a reader would receive it.
